subject.title: Group chat context handling can blur which messages are addressed to the current agent

question: Should the permanent fix be a durable core/channel target-metadata contract, a narrower prompt-only mitigation, or a per-channel context-isolation policy?
rationale: The requested behavior changes model-visible context and channel history semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the public contract, default behavior, or cross-channel rollout plan alone.

options.title: Approve Durable Target Metadata
options.body: Add typed current-agent versus other-agent metadata to history and reply context, wire Telegram first, and leave other channels to populate the same optional contract when ready.

options.title: Land Prompt Mitigation Only
options.body: Use prompt wording like the open maintainer PR as a stopgap while keeping this issue open for the durable metadata work.

options.title: Choose Channel Policy Instead
options.body: Define a per-channel context-isolation policy that filters or summarizes unrelated group history rather than expanding the shared history metadata contract first.

recommendation.title: Approve Durable Target Metadata
recommendation.body: Add typed current-agent versus other-agent metadata to history and reply context, wire Telegram first, and leave other channels to populate the same optional contract when ready.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the open prompt-mitigation PR and has prior merged history on the adjacent group prompt behavior, making him the best available decision owner from the inspected trail.
